capabilities: fetch a public social post by URL
bulk-fetch and select posts from a creator profile
save posts as Markdown notes with source properties and tags
download images and videos into the vault or keep media as links
manage credits and subscription plans in-plugin
extras: Freemium: 20 free credits monthly, paid plans and non-expiring credit add-ons; failed fetches do not consume credits. Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.11.4+), English interface, light theme only, no mobile support. Current release covers manual single-post and profile bulk fetch only; Auto Fetch and scheduled monitoring are not included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to save social media posts into a vault with their source URL, creator details, timestamps, and media preserved.

relations.evidence: Content retrieval is provided by AgentLens API and uses account credits.
Google | Authentication when you choose to register or sign in with Google.
Stripe | Subscription checkout and payment processing.

requires.name: AgentLens API credits (20 free per month; paid plans from $2.90/month)

summary: Importer that saves public posts from 21 social platforms as Markdown notes with source properties, tags, and optional locally downloaded media.
